'''SU-B713''', or '''Essyou''', was a [[Service droid/Legends|serving droid]] that was employed by the [[Hard Heart Cantina/Legends|Hard Heart Cantina]] aboard the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. It was programmed with a [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]].
